name: Erech Finance
summary: Erech Finance Cahalacha Ltd, alongside its associated companies, extends lending and credit provisions to a diverse clientele within Israel, including small and medium-sized businesses, community organizations, and private individuals. Furthermore, the firm has a notable involvement in the biotechnological sector, concentrating on the advancement of pharmaceutical solutions for juvenile diabetes and various cancer types. Established in 1998, its operational base is situated in Jerusalem, Israel.
